notes: Truck Characteristics Chart (SPI 54.2), 'maximum transport capacity' of one truck point of each class: CPA when motorising infantry, guns or (convoy trucks only, note *) carrying supplies; TOE Strength Points carried; Supply Points carried; fuel capacity; fuel consumption factor; Breakdown Adjustment Rating in column shifts left
The chart's 'na' (not allowed) is null. Light-truck infantry '½†': two light truck points motorise one infantry TOE point

Note ‡ on the light BAR: light trucks not moving along a road take one breakdown point more for each hex entered and each hexside crossed, on top of the terrain's own; the chart's example (track, one hex across a wadi into rough) totals 18
